projection_to_27_line_graph: bijection with all 1080 four-cycles of SRG(27,10,1,5)
four_cycle_count_proof: The line graph is SRG(27,10,1,5). It has 216 nonadjacent vertex pairs; each nonadjacent pair has 5 common neighbors, and choosing 2 common neighbors determines a 4-cycle with two opposite-pair descriptions. Hence 216*C(5,2)/2=1080.
theorem: The 1080 minimum binary Levi codewords form one PSp(4,3) orbit and one PGSp(4,3) orbit. They are exactly the twelvefold repetitions of Levi 8-cycles, equivalently the 1080 four-cycles of the 27-line Schlaefli graph, with stabilizers 24 and 48 respectively.
boundary: Binary minimum-shell orbit theorem only; no identification with ternary homology witnesses follows from the count 1080 alone.
